description: This file defines a React component 'GroupedBarChart' that renders a grouped bar chart visualization, along with a utility function 'formatDuration' for formatting durations. It imports CSS styling and uses SVG elements for rendering. The file includes logic for dynamic axis scaling and label formatting based on data values.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a string with seconds, minutes, or minutes and seconds.

methods.name: GroupedBarChart
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grouped bar chart visualization based on provided data, groups, and series.
